::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1885]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown.  Printed in Romanes, [<i>Appreciation</i>](other_books/otherbook_241.qmd), 184, 185.
:::

[To [Gertrude Mary Ireland Blackburne](people/person_160.qmd)]

I can’t help being attracted by ghost discussions, and there are some things that I very decidedly believe.

I don’t care much for [Nuttie](cmy_books/cmybook_183.qmd) myself. I am getting too old to write of the swing of modern life; I don’t see enough of it.

---

**Note:** *Nuttie's Father* was published in autumn 1885.
